name: WeeklyChallenge
brief: Weekly challenge: spin 50 times this week to open a chest. Show the progress, and let the player start the next week after collecting.
by: Claude Opus 5.5 (wrote the kit, dry run)
review: Built by the kit's author as a dry run of the tooling. Not evidence that a newcomer succeeds.

name: ComebackBonus
brief: Comeback bonus: a player returns after a week away. Welcome them back with a chest they can open, and beside it one special coin offer that expires in 30 minutes.
review: Brief says the offer sits beside the chest; the result stacked them and the offer badge overlapped the chest's Open button. No gate can see that. Owner changed one class to the new rk-template__pair helper. The agent edited economy.ts before starting the clock, so the time and the empty 'also changed' cell understate its work (it said so itself); whole agent run took 68 s. template:new now refuses a dirty tree.

name: VipLadder
brief: VIP ladder: players earn VIP points by buying coin packs. Show their VIP tier and their progress to the next tier. Buying a pack adds points, and reaching a new tier pays a chest.
review: Rule and numbers correct: 80 + 300 points land on tier 4 with 16 of 173, as worked out by hand. The chest appeared below the three packs, out of sight after a purchase; owner moved the stage above the packs. Whole agent run took 73 s.

name: DailyPrizeWheel
brief: Daily prize wheel: a wheel with eight prize segments. The player taps Spin, the wheel turns and lands on one prize, and they collect it. One spin per day.
gaps: No primitive draws or rotates a segmented wheel that lands on a chosen segment
review: Correct call: it did not fake a wheel. Whole agent run took 41 s. Showed the tooling had no clean way to stop; template:abandon was added because of this run.
